name: Signed Regulatory Net Increase Control (Full Descendant Control)
plain_language_rule: Predict treatment when The candidate drug independently affects the same disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:affects, biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates. No predicate descendants are excluded in this control.; Chemical causally affects regulator with an explicit increased or decreased activity direction The pinned descendant closure is biolink:affects, biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates. No predicate descendants are excluded in this control.; Regulator causally affects gene with an explicit increased or decreased activity direction The pinned descendant closure is biolink:affects, biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates. No predicate descendants are excluded in this control.; The downstream gene causes or contributes to the disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:causes, biolink:contributes_to. No predicate descendants are excluded in this control. The regulator and downstream disease gene must be different nodes. The two signs must agree, giving the net-increasing control.
hypothesis: Composing two signed activity effects tests a regulatory intervention rather than unsigned network proximity.

mechanism.rationale: Composing two signed activity effects tests a regulatory intervention rather than unsigned network proximity. The graph pattern is a hypothesis, not proof of clinical efficacy.

execution.cypher_template: MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[direct:{{relationship_types:direct}}]->(disease:Disease) WHERE direct.predicate IN {{predicates:direct}} MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[target:{{relationship_types:target}}]->(regulator:GeneOrGeneProduct) WHERE target.predicate IN {{predicates:target}} AND target.qualified_predicate = "biolink:causes" AND target.object_direction_qualifier IN ["increased","decreased"] AND target.object_aspect_qualifier IN ["activity","activity_or_abundance"] AND any(source IN ["infores:chembl","infores:gtopdb","infores:drugcentral"] WHERE source IN coalesce(target.primary_knowledge_sources,[])) MATCH (regulator:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[bridge:{{relationship_types:bridge}}]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct) WHERE bridge.predicate IN {{predicates:bridge}} AND bridge.qualified_predicate = "biolink:causes" AND bridge.object_direction_qualifier IN ["increased","decreased"] AND bridge.object_aspect_qualifier IN ["activity","activity_or_abundance"] MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[causal:{{relationship_types:causal}}]->(disease:Disease) WHERE causal.predicate IN {{predicates:causal}} AND (regulator<>gene) AND (target.object_direction_qualifier = bridge.object_direction_qualifier) RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,count(DISTINCT gene) AS support_count

trapi.limitations: Outside TRAPI: target: enforce primary-source membership in infores:chembl, infores:gtopdb, infores:drugcentral; The regulator and downstream disease gene must be different nodes.; The two signs must agree, giving the net-increasing control.

limitations: Unknown predictions are unlabeled, not known negatives.
Canonical graph identifiers are deduplicated; parallel evidence does not multiply gene support.
Source assertions lack dose, exposure, clinical context, and experimental causal validation.
The full affects closure includes ameliorates_condition and is classified as treatment-using even if no such edge satisfies the other constraints in this graph.
